name: Omprakash Jewellers
tagline: Gold, silver and work made by hand
heroTitle: Jewellery and craft from our shop in Porsa.
heroSubtitle: Gold, silver, stones, custom making, repair and polishing — visit the shop at Imli Chowk, Keshav Pasari ke saamne, or message us on WhatsApp. We do not sell online.

address.line1: Imli Chowk, Keshav Pasari ke saamne

aboutTitle: A neighbourhood jeweller that also makes and mends
aboutBody: Omprakash Jewellers is a single shop in Porsa. We sell gold and silver jewellery, and we also craft, resize, repair, polish and make pieces to order — not only gold and silver. Come to the counter, see the work, and talk to us in person.
